name: one-kettlebell-sumo-deadlift
instructions:
1. Position a kettlebell directly in between your feet and assume a moderately wide stance with your toes pointed slightly out.
2. Push your hips back and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel with the floor.
3. Reach down and grasp the kettlebell handle using a close, double overhand grip.
4. Drop your hips below your shoulders and ensure there is no slack in your arms.
5. Drive through the whole foot and focus on pushing the floor away by extending the knees and hips.
6. Once you have locked out the hips, reverse the movement by pushing the hips back and hinging forward.
7. Return the kettlebell to the floor, reset, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
